## Summary

This is PR **1 of a series** implement the eager-mode Sequence Parallel (SP) + Async-TP mechanism  . See the companion [RFC](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/61626) 


### E2E Test plan

**Server**  

```bash
# Baseline
VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn \
python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model Qwen/Qwen3-32B --port 8072 --host 0.0.0.0 --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-util=0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
    --max-num-batched-tokens=16384 --max-model-len=8448 --block-size 64 \
    -tp=4 --enforce-eager

# SP
VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn \
python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model Qwen/Qwen3-32B --port 8072 --host 0.0.0.0 --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-util=0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
    --max-num-batched-tokens=16384 --max-model-len=8448 --block-size 64 \
    -tp=4 --enforce-eager --enable-sequence-parallel

# AsyncTP
VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn \
python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model Qwen/Qwen3-32B --port 8072 --host 0.0.0.0 --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-util=0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
    --max-num-batched-tokens=16384 --max-model-len=8448 --block-size 64 \
    -tp=4 --enforce-eager --enable-sequence-parallel --enable-async-tp
```

**Client** (run against each server above; 4 shapes × 3 repeats each, `0` failed requests across all 36 runs):

```bash
# num-prompts:input-len:output-len in {16:8192:1, 16:4096:1, 16:256:128, 32:128:64}
python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve \
    --model Qwen/Qwen3-32B --ready-check-timeout-sec 1 --temperature=0 \
    --dataset-name random \
    --random-input-len=<input_len> --random-output-len=<output_len> \
    --ignore-eos --port=8072 --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --num-prompts <num_prompts> --request-rate inf --backend vllm \
    --trust-remote-code
```

**Accuracy** (GSM8K, 5-shot, 250 questions, in-process `vllm.LLM`, no server; `--limit 250` is the `acc.py` default):
 
### Results

| Shape (prompts:in:out) | Metric | baseline | sp | asynctp | sp vs. baseline | asynctp vs. baseline |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 16:8192:1 (prefill) | Total tok/s | 3851.05 | 3870.49 | 4762.88 | +0.5% | **+23.7%** |
| 16:8192:1 (prefill) | Mean TTFT (ms) | 19115.24 | 19029.64 | 15418.27 | -0.4% | **-19.3%** |
| 16:4096:1 (prefill) | Total tok/s | 4036.05 | 4058.00 | 5005.31 | +0.5% | **+24.0%** |
| 16:4096:1 (prefill) | Mean TTFT (ms) | 9988.02 | 9939.41 | 8053.10 | -0.5% | **-19.4%** |
| 16:256:128 (mixed) | Total tok/s | 1123.06 | 1107.70 | 1135.56 | -1.4% | +1.1% |
| 16:256:128 (mixed) | Mean TTFT (ms) | 989.85 | 1011.28 | 900.78 | +2.2% | **-9.0%** |
| 32:128:64 (mixed) | Total tok/s | 1732.93 | 1712.86 | 1869.17 | -1.2% | **+7.9%** |
| 32:128:64 (mixed) | Mean TTFT (ms) | 969.33 | 976.83 | 759.35 | +0.8% | **-21.7%** |

- `sp` alone (decoupled path, no fused kernel) is within ±1.4% of `baseline` on every shape — it trades one collective (all-reduce) for two (all-gather + reduce-scatter) without recovering the time via overlap, as  expected.
- `asynctp` (sp + fused AllGather+GEMM/GEMM+ReduceScatter) wins on every  shape, with the largest gains on the pure-prefill shapes where there's the  most communication to hide behind compute (+23-24% total tok/s, -19% TTFT).

#### Accuracy (GSM8K, 5-shot, 250 questions, single run each)

| Case | Accuracy | Invalid rate | Questions/s | Tokens/s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline | 0.676 | 0.0 | 11.737 | 2120.38 |
| sp | 0.660 | 0.0 | 11.635 | 2063.62 |
| asynctp | 0.668 | 0.0 | 12.267 | 2200.08 |

#### Kernel microbenchmark (TP=2, single linear layer, full M sweep 128→32768; `benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_sequence_parallel.py`)

- AG side (qkv/gate_up): SP always costs more than plain-TP `baseline` — expected, plain TP has no collective at this boundary at all.
- RS side (o/down): SP beats `baseline` once M is large enough (fused reaches ~-40% at M≥8192); `fused` only beats `unfused` once M≳512-1024, below that the overlap doesn't pay for the extra kernel overhead.
- Net e2e win only comes from AsyncTP's fused kernels overlapping the AG-side cost while keeping the RS-side savings — consistent with the E2E results above.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Benchmark the SP/AsyncTP comm+GEMM kernels in
+``vllm.model_executor.kernels.sequence_parallel`` against each other and
+against doing the GEMM and the collective separately.
+
+Two region-boundary directions are benchmarked, matching the two linear
+kinds ``mark_sp_region`` wraps:
+
+- ``qkv``/``gate_up`` (``--proj``): a ``ColumnParallelLinear`` *entering* an
+  SP region -- all-gather the token-sharded input, then GEMM.
+- ``o``/``down``: a ``RowParallelLinear`` *exiting* an SP region -- GEMM,
+  then reduce-scatter the output back to a token shard.
+
+For each, five candidates are timed:
+
+- ``gemm``: the GEMM alone, on the same (already-gathered) input the fused/
+  unfused paths feed it -- the compute floor.
+- ``collective``: the all-gather/reduce-scatter alone, on the same message
+  size -- the comm floor.
+- ``unfused``: what ``--enable-sequence-parallel`` runs without
+  ``--enable-async-tp`` -- a plain collective, then (or after) the layer's
+  own GEMM.
+- ``fused``: what ``--enable-async-tp`` swaps in instead -- a
+  symmetric-memory kernel that overlaps the collective with the GEMM,
+  chosen by ``init_fused_comm_kernel`` exactly as in serving.
+- ``baseline``: plain TP with neither SP nor AsyncTP enabled. For
+  ``qkv``/``gate_up`` this is identical to ``gemm`` (the input is already
+  full/replicated, so there is no collective at this boundary at all). For
+  ``o``/``down`` this is the GEMM followed by a full
+  ``tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce`` of the ``[M, N]`` partial sums --
+  what ``RowParallelLinear(reduce_results=True)`` actually runs -- not the
+  smaller reduce-scatter ``collective``/``unfused``/``fused`` use.
+
+Run a TP2 sweep over the Qwen3-32B projections with:
+
+    torchrun --nproc-per-node=2 -- \\
+        benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_sequence_parallel.py --proj qkv
+
+Runs on NVIDIA and AMD (ROCm) unchanged -- both expose CUDA-graph capture
+through ``torch.cuda``.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import statistics
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.config import ModelConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.distributed import cleanup_dist_env_and_memory
+from vllm.distributed.communication_op import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    get_tp_group,
+    graph_capture,
+    init_distributed_environment,
+    initialize_model_parallel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.sequence_parallel import (
+    LinearCommKernel,
+    init_fused_comm_kernel,
+    init_unfused_comm_kernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
+from vllm.models.common.ops.sequence_parallel import sp_all_gather, sp_reduce_scatter
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+# Per model: (N, K) for each projection, where N is the global output width
+# and K the global input width. qkv/gate_up are ColumnParallelLinear
+# (AllGather+GEMM); o/down are RowParallelLinear (GEMM+ReduceScatter).
+# Approximate public dense configs -- close enough for shape-accurate
+# latency, not a source of truth for the real checkpoints.
+_MODEL_PROJECTIONS: dict[str, dict[str, tuple[int, int]]] = {
+    "qwen3_0_6b": {
+        "qkv": (16 * 128 + 2 * 8 * 128, 1024),
+        "o": (1024, 16 * 128),
+        "gate_up": (2 * 3072, 1024),
+        "down": (1024, 3072),
+    },
+    "qwen3_1_7b": {
+        "qkv": (16 * 128 + 2 * 8 * 128, 2048),
+        "o": (2048, 16 * 128),
+        "gate_up": (2 * 6144, 2048),
+        "down": (2048, 6144),
+    },
+    "qwen3_32b": {
+        "qkv": (64 * 128 + 2 * 8 * 128, 5120),
+        "o": (5120, 64 * 128),
+        "gate_up": (2 * 25600, 5120),
+        "down": (5120, 25600),
+    },
+}
+
+# qkv/gate_up all-gather their (token-sharded) input then GEMM; o/down GEMM
+# then reduce-scatter their output.
+_AG_PROJECTIONS = {"qkv", "gate_up"}
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--proj",
+        choices=("qkv", "gate_up", "o", "down"),
+        default="gate_up",
+        help="Which SP region boundary to benchmark.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--model",
+        choices=tuple(_MODEL_PROJECTIONS),
+        default="qwen3_32b",
+        help="Model whose projection shapes (BF16) to benchmark.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--m",
+        type=int,
+        nargs="+",
+        default=[128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768],
+        help="Global token counts to benchmark.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--n", type=int, help="Output width override.")
+    parser.add_argument("--k", type=int, help="Input width override.")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--num-workspaces",
+        type=int,
+        default=10,
+        help="Pointer-distinct inputs and CUDA graphs to rotate.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--warmup-replays", type=int, default=5)
+    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=20)
+    parser.add_argument("--json", type=str, help="Also write the results here.")
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def make_linear(
+    proj: str,
+    n: int,
+    k: int,
+    world_size: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> ColumnParallelLinear | RowParallelLinear:
+    """Build the unquantized (BF16) ``LinearBase`` the real model would wire
+    ``mark_sp_region`` around for ``proj``."""
+    with torch.device(device):
+        if proj in _AG_PROJECTIONS:
+            linear = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                k,
+                n,
+                bias=False,
+                gather_output=False,
+                params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                return_bias=False,
+            )
+        else:
+            linear = RowParallelLinear(
+                k,
+                n,
+                bias=False,
+                params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                # The baseline reduce-scatters the local partial itself, as
+                # the unfused SP path does.
+                reduce_results=False,
+                return_bias=False,
+            )
+
+    weight = torch.randn(
+        linear.weight.shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=linear.weight.device
+    )
+    linear.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(weight, requires_grad=False)
+    linear.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(linear)
+    return linear
+
+
+def pick_fused_kernel(
+    linear: ColumnParallelLinear | RowParallelLinear,
+) -> LinearCommKernel | None:
+    """The kernel ``--enable-async-tp`` would swap in."""
+    return init_fused_comm_kernel(linear)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def accelerator_graph_apis():
+    """On NVIDIA/AMD, ``torch.cuda`` already *is* the graph/stream/event API
+    (ROCm's build hipifies it in place)."""
+    if not current_platform.is_xpu():
+        yield
+        return
+
+    from functools import partial
+
+    original = {
+        name: getattr(torch.cuda, name)
+        for name in (
+            "Stream",
+            "default_stream",
+            "current_stream",
+            "stream",
+            "set_stream",
+            "Event",
+            "graph",
+            "CUDAGraph",
+            "graph_pool_handle",
+            "is_current_stream_capturing",
+        )
+    }
+    torch.cuda.Stream = torch.xpu.Stream
+    torch.cuda.default_stream = partial(torch.xpu.current_stream)
+    torch.cuda.current_stream = partial(torch.xpu.current_stream)
+    torch.cuda.stream = partial(torch.xpu.stream)
+    torch.cuda.set_stream = partial(torch.xpu.set_stream)
+
+    def _xpu_event(*args, blocking=None, **kwargs):
+        return torch.xpu.Event(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    torch.cuda.Event = _xpu_event
+    torch.cuda.graph = partial(torch.xpu.graph)
+    torch.cuda.CUDAGraph = torch.xpu.XPUGraph
+    torch.cuda.graph_pool_handle = partial(torch.xpu.graph_pool_handle)
+    torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing = torch.xpu.is_current_stream_capturing
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        for name, value in original.items():
+            setattr(torch.cuda, name, value)
+
+
+def capture_graph(
+    op: Callable[[], torch.Tensor],
+    stream: torch.cuda.Stream,
+    cpu_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> torch.cuda.CUDAGraph:
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        for _ in range(3):
+            op()
+    stream.synchronize()
+    dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    # tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce (used by the "baseline" candidate) may
+    # dispatch to an IPC-backed custom all-reduce; graph_capture() is what
+    # makes that graph-safe, matching how real serving captures CUDA graphs.
+    with graph_capture(device=device), torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+        op()
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+    dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+    return graph
+
+
+def benchmark_graphs(
+    candidate_graphs: dict[str, list[torch.cuda.CUDAGraph]],
+    warmup_replays: int,
+    samples: int,
+    device_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+    device_barrier: Callable[[], None],
+) -> dict[str, float]:
+    """Median over samples of the slowest rank's replay time, in us."""
+    names = list(candidate_graphs)
+    for round_index in range(warmup_replays):
+        for offset in range(len(names)):
+            name = names[(round_index + offset) % len(names)]
+            graphs = candidate_graphs[name]
+            device_barrier()
+            graphs[round_index % len(graphs)].replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    timings: dict[str, list[float]] = {name: [] for name in names}
+    start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+    end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+    for sample_index in range(samples):
+        for offset in range(len(names)):
+            name = names[(sample_index + offset) % len(names)]
+            graphs = candidate_graphs[name]
+            device_barrier()
+            start.record()
+            graphs[sample_index % len(graphs)].replay()
+            end.record()
+            end.synchronize()
+
+            elapsed = torch.tensor(
+                start.elapsed_time(end) * 1000,
+                dtype=torch.float64,
+                device=torch.accelerator.current_device_index(),
+            )
+            dist.all_reduce(elapsed, op=dist.ReduceOp.MAX, group=device_group)
+            timings[name].append(elapsed.item())
+    return {name: statistics.median(values) for name, values in timings.items()}
+
+
+def benchmark_shape(
+    proj: str,
+    M: int,
+    N: int,
+    K: int,
+    num_workspaces: int,
+    warmup_replays: int,
+    samples: int,
+    device_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+    cpu_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+    device_barrier: Callable[[], None],
+) -> dict[str, float | int | str] | None:
+    is_ag = proj in _AG_PROJECTIONS
+    world_size = dist.get_world_size(device_group)
+    rank = dist.get_rank(device_group)
+    device = torch.device(
+        torch.accelerator.current_accelerator().type,
+        torch.accelerator.current_device_index(),
+    )
+    local_M = (M + world_size - 1) // world_size
+
+    rng = torch.Generator(device=device)
+    rng.manual_seed(1000 + rank * 10 + M + K)
+    linears = [
+        make_linear(proj, N, K, world_size, device) for _ in range(num_workspaces)
+    ]
+
+    fused = pick_fused_kernel(linears[0])
+    if fused is None:
+        print(f"[M={M}, N={N}, K={K}] no fused kernel supports this shape; skipping")
+        return None
+    unfused_kernels = [init_unfused_comm_kernel(linear) for linear in linears]
+    fused_kernels = [fused] + [pick_fused_kernel(linear) for linear in linears[1:]]
+    assert all(k is not None for k in fused_kernels), (
+        "fused-kernel support should only depend on shape, which is "
+        "identical across workspaces"
+    )
+
+    if is_ag:
+        # Token-sharded input: [local_M, K] per rank, all-gathered to
+        # [M, K] before the GEMM.
+        locals_ = [
+            torch.randn(local_M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device, generator=rng)
+            for _ in range(num_workspaces)
+        ]
+        gathered = [sp_all_gather(x) for x in locals_]
+
+        def bare_gemm(linear=None, x=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+            return linear.quant_method.apply(linear, x)
+
+        def bare_collective(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+            return sp_all_gather(x)
+
+        candidates: dict[str, list[Callable[[], torch.Tensor]]] = {
+            "gemm": [
+                lambda ln=ln, x=x: bare_gemm(ln, x) for ln, x in zip(linears, gathered)
+            ],
+            "collective": [lambda x=x: bare_collective(x) for x in locals_],
+            "unfused": [
+                lambda k=k, x=x: k.apply(x) for k, x in zip(unfused_kernels, locals_)
+            ],
+            "fused": [
+                lambda k=k, x=x: k.apply(x) for k, x in zip(fused_kernels, locals_)
+            ],
+            # Plain TP (no SP): the input entering this projection is
+            # already full/replicated across ranks, so there is no
+            # collective here at all -- this is just the GEMM alone,
+            # identical to "gemm" above.
+            "baseline": [
+                lambda ln=ln, x=x: bare_gemm(ln, x) for ln, x in zip(linears, gathered)
+            ],
+        }
+        correctness_input = locals_[0]
+        # Both paths all-gather the full token dim first, so every rank's
+        # output already covers every row -- nothing to slice off.
+        correctness_rows = slice(None)
+    else:
+        # Full input [M, K_local] per rank; the GEMM output [M, N] is
+        # reduce-scattered to [local_M, N].
+        local_K = K // world_size
+        fulls = [
+            torch.randn(M, local_K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device, generator=rng)
+            for _ in range(num_workspaces)
+        ]
+        partials = [
+            linear.quant_method.apply(linear, x) for linear, x in zip(linears, fulls)
+        ]
+
+        def bare_gemm(linear=None, x=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+            return linear.quant_method.apply(linear, x)
+
+        def bare_collective(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+            return sp_reduce_scatter(x)
+
+        def bare_gemm_allreduce(linear=None, x=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+            # Plain TP (no SP): GEMM on the local K-shard, then a full
+            # all-reduce of the [M, N] partial sums (not a reduce-scatter)
+            # -- what RowParallelLinear(reduce_results=True) does.
+            return tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(bare_gemm(linear, x))
+
+        candidates = {
+            "gemm": [
+                lambda ln=ln, x=x: bare_gemm(ln, x) for ln, x in zip(linears, fulls)
+            ],
+            "collective": [lambda p=p: bare_collective(p) for p in partials],
+            "unfused": [
+                lambda k=k, x=x: k.apply(x) for k, x in zip(unfused_kernels, fulls)
+            ],
+            "fused": [
+                lambda k=k, x=x: k.apply(x) for k, x in zip(fused_kernels, fulls)
+            ],
+            "baseline": [
+                lambda ln=ln, x=x: bare_gemm_allreduce(ln, x)
+                for ln, x in zip(linears, fulls)
+            ],
+        }
+        correctness_input = fulls[0]
+        correctness_rows = slice(0, local_M)
+
+    expected = unfused_kernels[0].apply(correctness_input)
+    actual = fused_kernels[0].apply(correctness_input)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize(device)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        actual[correctness_rows],
+        expected[correctness_rows],
+        rtol=5e-2,
+        atol=4.0,
+        msg=f"proj={proj}, M={M}, N={N}, K={K}",
+    )
+
+    candidate_graphs = {}
+    keepalive: list[object] = []
+    for name, ops in candidates.items():
+        stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        candidate_graphs[name] = [
+            capture_graph(op, stream, cpu_group, device) for op in ops
+        ]
+        keepalive.append(stream)
+
+    times = benchmark_graphs(
+        candidate_graphs, warmup_replays, samples, device_group, device_barrier
+    )
+    floor = max(times["gemm"], times["collective"])
+    return {
+        "proj": proj,
+        "fused_kernel": type(fused_kernels[0]).__name__,
+        "M": M,
+        "N": N,
+        "K": K,
+        "gemm_us": times["gemm"],
+        "collective_us": times["collective"],
+        "floor_us": floor,
+        "unfused_us": times["unfused"],
+        "fused_us": times["fused"],
+        "fused_vs_unfused": (times["fused"] - times["unfused"]) / times["unfused"],
+        "fused_vs_floor": (times["fused"] - floor) / floor,
+        "baseline_us": times["baseline"],
+        "unfused_vs_baseline": (
+            (times["unfused"] - times["baseline"]) / times["baseline"]
+        ),
+        "fused_vs_baseline": (times["fused"] - times["baseline"]) / times["baseline"],
+    }
+
+
+def print_results(results: list[dict[str, float | int | str]]) -> None:
+    proj = results[0]["proj"]
+    kernel = results[0]["fused_kernel"]
+    print(f"### {proj} SP kernels (bf16, fused={kernel})")
+    print(
+        "| M | N | K | GEMM (us) | collective (us) | floor (us) | "
+        "unfused (us) | fused (us) | fused vs unfused | fused vs floor | "
+        "baseline (us) | unfused vs baseline | fused vs baseline |"
+    )
+    print("|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|")
+    for r in results:
+        print(
+            f"| {r['M']} | {r['N']} | {r['K']} | {r['gemm_us']:.1f} | "
+            f"{r['collective_us']:.1f} | {r['floor_us']:.1f} | "
+            f"{r['unfused_us']:.1f} | {r['fused_us']:.1f} | "
+            f"{r['fused_vs_unfused']:+.1%} | {r['fused_vs_floor']:+.1%} | "
+            f"{r['baseline_us']:.1f} | {r['unfused_vs_baseline']:+.1%} | "
+            f"{r['fused_vs_baseline']:+.1%} |"
+        )
+
+
+def make_device_barrier(tp_group) -> Callable[[], None]:
+    """A cheap device-side rendezvous to order each timed replay after every
+    rank reaches it, without including the rendezvous itself in the timed
+    interval (it runs before ``start.record()``).
+

+def main() -> None:
+    args = parse_args()
+    default_n, default_k = _MODEL_PROJECTIONS[args.model][args.proj]
+    n = args.n or default_n
+    k = args.k or default_k
+    assert args.m and min(args.m) > 0
+    k_alignment = 64
+    assert n % k_alignment == 0 and k % k_alignment == 0
+    assert args.num_workspaces > 0
+    assert args.warmup_replays >= 0
+    assert args.samples > 0
+
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(local_rank)
+    init_distributed_environment(backend=current_platform.dist_backend)
+    world_size = dist.get_world_size()
+
+    config = VllmConfig()
+    config.model_config = ModelConfig(dtype="bfloat16")
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        # Builds the TP communicator as in serving, and enables the
+        # symmetric-memory group the fused kernels rely on.
+        initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=world_size)
+
+    tp_group = get_tp_group()
+    device_barrier = make_device_barrier(tp_group)
+
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config), accelerator_graph_apis():
+        results = [
+            r
+            for M in args.m
+            if (
+                r := benchmark_shape(
+                    args.proj,
+                    M,
+                    n,
+                    k,
+                    args.num_workspaces,
+                    args.warmup_replays,
+                    args.samples,
+                    tp_group.device_group,
+                    tp_group.cpu_group,
+                    device_barrier,
+                )
+            )
+            is not None
+        ]
+
+    if tp_group.rank_in_group == 0 and results:
+        print_results(results)
+        if args.json:
+            with open(args.json, "w") as f:
+                json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
+
+    dist.barrier(group=tp_group.cpu_group)
+    cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Shared infrastructure for e2e correctness tests of model-level sequence
+parallelism (``--enable-sequence-parallel``) and its fused comm+GEMM kernels
+(``--enable-async-tp``) against a plain TP baseline.
+
+Each model's own ``test_sequence_parallel.py`` (e.g.
+``tests/models/qwen3/test_sequence_parallel.py``) defines its model list and
+calls ``run_tp_sp_generation_test`` from a parametrized test.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Literal, NamedTuple
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.config.model import RunnerOption
+
+from ..models.registry import HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS, _HfExamplesInfo
+from ..utils import compare_all_settings
+
+
+class ParallelSetup(NamedTuple):
+    tp_size: int
+    pp_size: int
+    enable_async_tp: bool
+
+
+class SPTestOptions(NamedTuple):
+    load_format: str | None = None
+    model_info: _HfExamplesInfo | None = None
+    quantization: str | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SPTestSettings:
+    parallel_setups: list[ParallelSetup]
+    runner: RunnerOption
+    test_options: SPTestOptions
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def default(
+        *,
+        tp_base: int = 2,
+        pp_base: int = 1,
+        runner: RunnerOption = "auto",
+        load_format: str | None = None,
+        model_info: _HfExamplesInfo | None = None,
+        quantization: str | None = None,
+    ):
+        # Both the unfused (plain all_gather/reduce_scatter) and fused
+        # (symmetric-memory AllGather+GEMM / GEMM+ReduceScatter) SP kernels,
+        # each vs. a no-SP TP baseline. Always run in eager mode (see
+        # ``build_sp_args``) since the fused kernels rely on symmetric
+        # memory, whose CUDA graph behavior isn't the concern of this test.
+        parallel_setups = [
+            ParallelSetup(tp_size=tp_base, pp_size=pp_base, enable_async_tp=async_tp)
+            for async_tp in [False, True]
+        ]
+        return SPTestSettings(
+            parallel_setups=parallel_setups,
+            runner=runner,
+            test_options=SPTestOptions(
+                load_format=load_format,
+                model_info=model_info,
+                quantization=quantization,
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def iter_params(self, model_id: str):
+        opts = self.test_options
+
+        for parallel_setup in self.parallel_setups:
+            yield (model_id, parallel_setup, self.runner, opts)
+
+
+def build_sp_args(
+    model_id: str,
+    parallel_setup: ParallelSetup,
+    runner: RunnerOption,
+    test_options: SPTestOptions,
+    num_gpus_available: int,
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]] | None:
+    tp_size, pp_size, enable_async_tp = parallel_setup
+
+    if num_gpus_available < tp_size * pp_size:
+        return None
+
+    load_format = test_options.load_format
+
+    model_info = test_options.model_info or HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS.find_hf_info(model_id)
+    model_info.check_transformers_version(on_fail="skip")
+
+    trust_remote_code = model_info.trust_remote_code
+    tokenizer_mode = model_info.tokenizer_mode
+
+    if load_format != "dummy":
+        model_info.check_available_online(on_fail="skip")
+
+    common_args = [
+        "--dtype",
+        "bfloat16",
+        "--max-model-len",
+        "2048",
+        "--max-num-seqs",
+        "8",
+        # Hardcode eager mode: the fused kernels rely on symmetric memory,
+        # and CUDA graph interaction with it isn't the concern of this
+        # correctness test.
+        "--enforce-eager",
+    ]
+    if runner != "auto":
+        common_args.extend(["--runner", runner])
+    if trust_remote_code:
+        common_args.append("--trust-remote-code")
+    if tokenizer_mode:
+        common_args.extend(["--tokenizer-mode", tokenizer_mode])
+    if load_format:
+        common_args.extend(["--load-format", load_format])
+    if test_options.quantization:
+        common_args.extend(["--quantization", test_options.quantization])
+
+    tp_args = [
+        *common_args,
+        "--tensor-parallel-size",
+        str(tp_size),
+        "--pipeline-parallel-size",
+        str(pp_size),
+        "--distributed-executor-backend",
+        "mp",
+    ]
+
+    tp_sp_args = [
+        *tp_args,
+        "--enable-sequence-parallel",
+        "--sequence-parallel-min-tokens",
+        "0",
+    ]
+    if enable_async_tp:
+        tp_sp_args.append("--enable-async-tp")
+
+    return tp_args, tp_sp_args
+
+
+def _compare_sp_settings(
+    model_id: str,
+    settings: list[tuple[list[str], list[str]]],
+    *,
+    method: Literal["generate", "encode"],
+) -> None:
+    if not settings:
+        pytest.skip("No supported sequence-parallel configurations")
+
+    settings_by_tp_args: dict[tuple[str, ...], list[list[str]]] = {}
+    for tp_args, tp_sp_args in settings:
+        settings_by_tp_args.setdefault(tuple(tp_args), []).append(tp_sp_args)
+
+    for tp_args_key, grouped_tp_sp_args in settings_by_tp_args.items():
+        all_args = [list(tp_args_key), *grouped_tp_sp_args]
+        compare_all_settings(
+            model_id,
+            all_args,
+            [None] * len(all_args),
+            method=method,
+        )
+
+
+def run_tp_sp_generation_test(
+    model_id: str,
+    settings: SPTestSettings,
+    num_gpus_available: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Compare ``--enable-sequence-parallel``/``--enable-async-tp`` text
+    generation against a plain TP baseline for every parallel setup in
+    ``settings``."""
+    comparisons = []
+    for _, parallel_setup, runner, test_options in settings.iter_params(model_id):
+        comparison = build_sp_args(
+            model_id,
+            parallel_setup,
+            runner,
+            test_options,
+            num_gpus_available,
+        )
+        if comparison is not None:
+            comparisons.append(comparison)
+
+    _compare_sp_settings(model_id, comparisons, method="generate")

+class _StubLayer:

+    def __init__(self) -> None:

+def _make_model(

+def test_wires_mark_sp_region_per_layer_boundary(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):

+    norm (``exit_before=None``), not at another layer's input."""
+    calls: list[tuple[object, object]] = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        qwen3_model,

+    parallel_config = ParallelConfig(

+    _, layers = _make_model(monkeypatch, parallel_config, num_layers=2)

+    expected = []

+

+
+
+class LinearCommKernel(ABC):
+    """Comm+GEMM for a linear layer at an SP region boundary. ``apply``
+    replaces the layer's ``forward`` while SP is active."""
+
+    def __init__(self, layer: LinearBase) -> None:
+        self.layer = layer
+        self.layer_forward = layer.forward
+
+    @classmethod
+    @abstractmethod
+    def is_supported(cls, layer: LinearBase) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def apply(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @contextmanager
+    def _replace(source: MethodType, target: Callable):
+        """Swap the bound method ``source`` for ``target`` for one call."""
+        owner, name = source.__self__, source.__name__
+        setattr(owner, name, target)
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            setattr(owner, name, source)
+
+    def column_parallel_forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
+        """``ColumnParallelLinear.forward``, called through the pre-patch
+        bound method captured in ``__init__`` so it still goes through
+        ``apply``'s swapped-out quant method GEMM."""
+        return self.layer_forward(x)
+
+    def row_parallel_forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        reduce_scatter: bool = False,
+    ) -> Any:
+        """``RowParallelLinear.forward`` with the all-reduce replaced by
+        ``reduce_scatter``, or by nothing if the GEMM already scatters its
+        output. Each rank then adds the bias to its own token shard."""
+        layer = self.layer
+        assert layer.input_is_parallel
+        output = layer.quant_method.apply(layer, x)
+        if reduce_scatter:
+            output = sp_reduce_scatter(output)
+        bias = layer.bias
+        if bias is not None and not layer.skip_bias_add:
+            output = output + bias
+        if not layer.return_bias:
+            return output
+        return output, bias if layer.skip_bias_add else None
+
+
+class FusedCommGemmKernel(LinearCommKernel):
+    """A ``LinearCommKernel`` that works by swapping out the quant
+    method's GEMM for one call, fusing a symmetric-memory collective into it.
+
+    Subclasses implement ``source_gemm_method`` (the bound GEMM method to
+    replace) and ``target_gemm_method`` (the fused comm+GEMM replacement,
+    with the same signature as the source method).
+    """
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def source_gemm_method(self) -> MethodType:
+        """The quant method's GEMM method this kernel fuses a collective
+        into, e.g. ``self._fp8_kernel.apply_scaled_mm``."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def target_gemm_method(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Fused comm+GEMM replacement for ``source_gemm_method``, with the
+        same signature."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class FusedAllGatherGemmKernel(FusedCommGemmKernel):
+    """Symmetric-memory AllGather + GEMM for the ``ColumnParallelLinear``
+    exiting an SP region."""
+
+    def apply(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
+        with self._replace(self.source_gemm_method(), self.target_gemm_method):
+            return self.column_parallel_forward(x)
+
+
+class FusedGemmReduceScatterKernel(FusedCommGemmKernel):
+    """Symmetric-memory GEMM + ReduceScatter for the ``RowParallelLinear``
+    entering an SP region. ``target_gemm_method`` already scatters its
+    output, so no further reduce-scatter is applied."""
+
+    def apply(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
+        with self._replace(self.source_gemm_method(), self.target_gemm_method):
+            return self.row_parallel_forward(x)
+
+
+class UnfusedAllGatherGemm(LinearCommKernel):
+    """All-gather the input shard, then the layer's plain ``forward``.
+
+    ``all_gather_input`` controls whether ``apply`` all-gathers ``x`` itself
+    before calling ``forward``. Subclasses that instead gather some
+    derivative of ``x`` (e.g. a quantized activation) from within a swapped
+    GEMM method should pass ``all_gather_input=False``.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, layer: LinearBase, all_gather_input: bool = True) -> None:
+        self.all_gather_input = all_gather_input
+        super().__init__(layer)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(cls, layer: LinearBase) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        return True, None
+
+    def apply(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
+        if self.all_gather_input:
+            x = sp_all_gather(x)
+        return self.column_parallel_forward(x)
+
+
+class UnfusedGemmReduceScatter(LinearCommKernel):
+    """The layer's GEMM, then reduce-scatter."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(cls, layer: LinearBase) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        return True, None
+
+    def apply(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
+        return self.row_parallel_forward(x, reduce_scatter=True)

+class FusedAllGatherGemm(FusedAllGatherGemmKernel):
+    def __init__(self, layer: LinearBase) -> None:
+        self._group_name = get_tp_group().device_group.group_name
+        enable_symm_mem_for_group(self._group_name)
+        super().__init__(layer)
+
+    def source_gemm_method(self):
+        return self.layer.quant_method.apply
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(cls, layer: LinearBase) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if type(layer.quant_method) is not UnquantizedLinearMethod:
+            return False, "requires UnquantizedLinearMethod"
+        return True, None
+
+    def target_gemm_method(
+        self,
+        layer: LinearBase,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        W = layer.weight.t()
+        _, mm_outputs = torch.ops.symm_mem.fused_all_gather_matmul(
+            x, [W], gather_dim=0, group_name=self._group_name
+        )
+        output = mm_outputs[0]
+        if bias is not None:
+            output = output + bias
+        return output
+

+    def __init__(self, layer: LinearBase) -> None:
+        self._group_name = get_tp_group().device_group.group_name
+        enable_symm_mem_for_group(self._group_name)
+        super().__init__(layer)
+

+    def is_supported(cls, layer: LinearBase) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if type(layer.quant_method) is not UnquantizedLinearMethod:
+            return False, "requires UnquantizedLinearMethod"
+        return True, None
+
+    def target_gemm_method(
+        self,
+        layer: LinearBase,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        W = layer.weight.t()
+        output = torch.ops.symm_mem.fused_matmul_reduce_scatter(
+            x, W, "sum", scatter_dim=0, group_name=self._group_name
+        )
